evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature (v2.1.88). Fills a genuine observability gap: before this hook, auto mode denials were invisible to scripts and logs. Integration is drop-in — same shell script pattern as existing 20 hooks. Capability expansion is high because we run permissions.defaultMode: 'auto' globally and currently have zero visibility into denied operations. Token efficiency is neutral (hooks run outside conversation). Action: document as hook #21 in hook-lifecycle skill, add example logger script, optionally wire to event bus for heartbeat monitoring.
